edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the token source.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as spender for the allowance deduction.
Caller-controlled addresses reach the core _transfer routine.
approve() passes msg.sender as the allowance owner.
Constructor derives the owner from _msgSender(), so the deployer is the sole privileged principal.
setBots is protected by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to _owner.
delBot is protected by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to _owner.
setCooldownEnabled is protected by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to _owner.
renounceOwnership is protected by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to _owner.
openTrading is protected by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to _owner.
manualswap authorizes msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1.
block.timestamp is read and written into the cooldown mapping, making the transfer gate miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is passed as the deadline to addLiquidityETH.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
_transfer performs the external swap via swapTokensForEth before the _tokenTransfer state mutation, so a malicious router/pair can re-enter.
_transfer triggers native ETH transfers to fee wallets mid-transfer flow.
swapTokensForEth makes an untrusted external router call with amountOutMin 0.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH with .transfer to attacker-influenceable fee wallets.
openTrading performs an external payable addLiquidityETH call with zero minimums.
openTrading calls the untrusted factory createPair.
openTrading grants an unlimited approval to the router on the pair token.
manualswap re-enters the swap routine from an external caller entry point.
manualsend re-enters the ETH payout routine from an external caller entry point.
_transfer delegates to _tokenTransfer after the checks.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard invokes _takeTeam.
_transferStandard invokes _reflectFee.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for supply figures.
Fee and team percentages are multiplied and divided on user-supplied amounts; overflow/underflow behaviour decides the resulting balances.
Reflection amounts are produced by mul/sub chains feeding the _rOwned bookkeeping.
_transferStandard debits the sender and credits the recipient in _rOwned.
_transferStandard indirectly shrinks _rTotal through the fee reflection.
_transferStandard indirectly grows _tFeeTotal.
_takeTeam credits the contract's _rOwned balance.
_takeTeam reads the reflection supply via _getRate.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee.
_transfer resets the first fee percentage.
_transfer resets the second fee percentage.
_transfer reads the blacklist mapping to gate transfers.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping.
_transfer enforces the max transaction amount.
_transfer gates the automatic swap on swapEnabled.
_transfer gates the cooldown logic on cooldownEnabled.
swapTokensForEth calls the stored router.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve, writing _allowances.
openTrading stores the router instance.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
openTrading sets the max transaction amount.
openTrading enables swaps.
openTrading enables the cooldown.
openTrading flips the tradingOpen guard.
setBots marks addresses as bots.
delBot clears the bot flag.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldown flag.
renounceOwnership zeroes the owner address.
Constructor writes the initial owner.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
approve() delegates to _approve.
transferFrom() reduces the allowance via _approve.
transferFrom() performs the move through _transfer.
transfer() performs the move through _transfer.
balanceOf() converts reflections with tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection() uses _getRate for the conversion ratio.
tokenFromReflection() validates the amount against _rTotal.
Fee wallet 1 is a recipient of the ETH payout.
Fee wallet 2 is a recipient of the ETH payout.
manualswap authorization compares the caller with the stored fee wallet 1.
manualsend authorization compares the caller with the stored fee wallet 1.
The contract token balance local is forwarded as the swap input amount.
The cached _msgSender() local seeds the initial owner assignment.

normalization_plan.reason: The from address only exists to feed _transfer's blacklist, pair and sending-address checks.
The to address only exists to feed _transfer's blacklist, cooldown and pair checks.
The amount parameter is consumed solely by the _maxTxAmount check and the downstream transfer math.
The sender parameter is only used to debit the _rOwned ledger inside _transferStandard.
The recipient parameter is only used to credit the _rOwned ledger inside _transferStandard.
The token amount parameter is purely an input to the fee/reflection value derivation.
The token amount parameter is only used as the swap input and router approval amount.
The address array exists only to populate the bots blacklist mapping.
The address parameter only clears a single bots mapping entry.
The boolean parameter only writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
The account parameter is only read as an index into _rOwned for the balance conversion.
The local balance snapshot is used only to size the automatic swap inside _transfer.
The local ETH snapshot only guards the sendETHToFee call inside _transfer.
The path array only parameterizes the router swap call.
The local rate value only carries the result of the _getRate division.
The cached caller local only serves the owner and supply initialization in the constructor.
